plplot/plplot.manifest:
name="plplot"
version="5.15.0"
license="LGPL-2.0-or-later"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=["bindings/fortran"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
link=["plplot"]
[install]
library=true

scope: The unmodified PLplot 5.15.0 modern Fortran binding modules are compiled with GNU Fortran 16 against Debian libplplot 5.15.0+dfsg2-15+b1. The author CMake precision template is configured with c_double to match the native double-precision C core; the generated include is checksum-locked. Original included parameter/interface sources and LGPL notices are retained. The checked main follows the author plinit/plenv/pllab/plline/plend API, checks finite sine samples and known extrema, requests the headless pngcairo driver at 800x500, and verifies the generated PNG signature and nontrivial size. The sandbox must return a browser-viewable PNG, which is visually reviewed. Q covers graphics. Native C/Cairo libraries and fonts are installed only in this package image; no precompiled Debian Fortran module files are used by the consumer. Interactive windows, other output drivers and the full upstream example/test suite are not verified.
configuration: Original Fortran bindings compiled with GNU 16 against Debian PLplot 5.15.0 C core; configured PLFLT uses c_double. No upstream Fortran .mod files are reused.
